definitions.short: to scrutinize ; by implication (of watching) to expect (with hope and patience)
definitions.full: H7663. sabar I. [ שָׂבַר ] verb inspect, examine (van d. H. שֹׁבֵר [so ᵐ5 συντρίβων ], but Masoretic ׳שׂ see Norzi; hence connection with Arabic probe a wound, try, examine , improbable, and this (according to Frä 261 ) denominative from Aramaic loan-word; improbable also is connection with Aramaic סְבַר think (compare following), Kau Aramaic in AT, 85 ); — Qal Participle שׂבֵר , with ב object, Neh 2:13 , 15 I examined into the wall, inspected it closely. II. [ שָׂבַר ] Pi`el wait, hope (Aramaism; compare Aramaic סְבַר think, Pa`el hope ; believe, hope , Pa`el think , Aph`el hope ); — Perfect 1singular שִׂבַּרְתִּי Psa 119:166 , 3 plural שִׂבְּרוּ Est 9:1 ; Imperfect 3masculine plural יְשַׂבְּרוּ Isa 38:18 , יְשַׂבֵּ֑רוּ Psa 145:15 , יְשַׂבֵּר֑וּן 104:27 ; 2 feminine plural תְּשַׂבֵּרְנָה Ruth 1:13 ; — 1 wait for, ל person, Ruth 1:13 . 2 hope for, ל of thing Psa 119:166 , אֶל of thing Isa 38:18 , אֶל person Psa 104:27 ; 145:15 ; ל infinitive Est 9:1 hope to rule .
